title: Tower Semiconductor Beats Second-Quarter Estimates and Issues Strong Q3 Revenue Outlook

content_html:
Tower Semiconductor (NASDAQ:TSEM) reported second-quarter 2026 results that surpassed Wall Street expectations and issued third-quarter revenue guidance that came in well above analyst forecasts.

The stronger outlook helped lift the company's shares 1.37% in pre-market trading.

Revenue and Earnings Top Expectations

Tower Semiconductor posted adjusted earnings of $0.88 per share, exceeding the analyst consensus estimate of $0.67 by $0.21.

Quarterly revenue reached a record $460.08 million, ahead of market expectations of $437.33 million and up 24% from $372.06 million in the second quarter of 2025.

The results reflected continued demand across several of the company's core semiconductor businesses.

Third-Quarter Guidance Beats Consensus

For the third quarter of 2026, Tower Semiconductor forecast revenue of approximately $520 million, with a potential variance of plus or minus 5%.

The midpoint of the guidance is around $30 million above the analyst consensus estimate of $490 million and implies year-over-year growth of approximately 31%.

CEO Highlights Strong Demand and Capacity Expansion

Chief Executive Officer Russell Ellwanger said the company delivered record financial performance while continuing to expand its manufacturing footprint.

"Amidst a powerful demand momentum across Tower's key business units, we achieved record revenue and record profitability, whilst simultaneously strengthening our technology leadership and greatly expanding manufacturing capacity throughout 2026."

Profitability Reaches Record Levels

Adjusted net profit totalled $100.71 million during the quarter, representing a net margin of 20%.

Gross profit climbed to a record $138 million, an increase of 72% from $80 million in the same period last year.

Operating profit reached $90 million, more than doubling the $40 million reported a year earlier.

Silicon Photonics Continues Rapid Growth

Tower Semiconductor said its Silicon Photonics business achieved an annual revenue run rate of $680 million during the second quarter, up from $180 million in the corresponding period of 2025.

The company expects that figure to exceed a $1 billion annual run rate by the fourth quarter of 2026.

During the quarter, Tower generated $177 million in operating cash flow while investing $187 million in property and equipment to support future growth.

content_html_zh:
Tower Semiconductor（纳斯达克股票代码：TSEM）公布的 2026 年第二季度业绩超出了华尔街预期，并发布了远高于分析师预测的第三季度收入指引。

更强劲的前景帮助该公司股价在盘前交易中上涨 1.37%。

收入和盈利最高预期

Tower Semiconductor 公布调整后每股收益 0.88 美元，比分析师普遍预期的 0.67 美元高出 0.21 美元。

季度收入达到创纪录的 4.6008 亿美元，超出市场预期的 4.3733 亿美元，比 2025 年第二季度的 3.7206 亿美元增长 24%。

该结果反映了该公司几个核心半导体业务的持续需求。

第三季度指导超出共识

Tower Semiconductor 预计 2026 年第三季度营收约为 5.2 亿美元，潜在差异为正负 5%。

该指引的中值比分析师普遍预期的 4.9 亿美元高出约 3000 万美元，意味着同比增长约 31%。

首席执行官强调强劲的需求和产能扩张

首席执行官拉塞尔·埃尔旺格 (Russell Ellwanger) 表示，该公司在继续扩大其制造业务的同时，实现了创纪录的财务业绩。

“在 Tower 关键业务部门强劲的需求势头下，我们实现了创纪录的收入和创纪录的盈利能力，同时加强了我们的技术领先地位，并在 2026 年大幅扩大了制造能力。”

盈利能力达到创纪录水平

该季度调整后净利润总计 1.0071 亿美元，净利润率为 20%。

毛利润攀升至创纪录的1.38亿美元，较去年同期的8000万美元增长72%。

营业利润达到 9000 万美元，比上年同期的 4000 万美元增加了一倍多。

硅光子学持续快速增长

Tower Semiconductor表示，其硅光子业务第二季度的年收入运行率为6.8亿美元，高于2025年同期的1.8亿美元。

该公司预计到 2026 年第四季度，这一数字将超过 10 亿美元的年运行率。

本季度，Tower 产生了 1.77 亿美元的运营现金流，同时投资了 1.87 亿美元的财产和设备以支持未来的增长。
